subject: Agriculture
title: Neonicotinoids and Bees
description: A fast breakdown of Neonicotinoids and Bees for builders.

hook.text: Neonicotinoids are the world's most used insecticides. They're also implicated in the global bee decline.

buildup.text: Neonics are systemic—applied to seeds, absorbed by plants, and expressed in pollen and nectar. Bees consume them.

discovery.text: Sub-lethal doses disorient bees—they can't navigate home. Colonies weaken and collapse over time.

twist.text: The EU banned outdoor use of three neonics in 2018. Most other countries still allow them.

climax.text: Bees pollinate 75% of food crops. Losing them threatens agriculture far more than the pests neonics target.

punchline.text: We poisoned the pollinators to protect the crops they pollinate.

quiz.question: How do neonicotinoid insecticides affect bees?
options: Sub-lethal doses disorient bees so they can't navigate home
